column2: File that would need to change
column3: app/main.py only. Existing GET /json/version handler (app/main.py:63-69) is the direct precedent. No changes needed to models.py, schemas.py, storage.py, or business_rules.py — no request body, no persistence, no business rule involved.

@app.get("/version", tags=["root"]) def version() -> dict: return {"version": app.version} — placed near json_version() (app/main.py:63-69), reuses app.version (set at app/main.py:32-36). No new imports, no new Pydantic model needed.

Add, not update. tests/test_tasks.py has no test for /, /json/version, or /health currently (all 44 existing tests are task/comment CRUD). Add a new test, e.g. test_get_version_returns_200_and_version_string, asserting 200 status and version key in response body.
pytest -v (per CLAUDE.md section 3, discovers full suite under tests/). Optional manual check: uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000, then curl http://localhost:8000/version

Don't let /version duplicate or diverge from /json/version without a scope decision first. Don't return more than a version string (no build hash, git SHA, env info) unless requested. Don't add a Pydantic response model — keep plain dict like root() and json_version(). Don't touch CORS config, tags structure, or existing routes. No dependency, Docker, CI, auth, database, or frontend changes.
